scripts.dev: npm run db:setup && npm run dev:app
scripts.dev:fresh: npm run db:reset && npm run dev:app
scripts.build: npm run build -w @isocal/frontend && npm run build -w @isocal/backend && node scripts/copy-frontend-build.mjs && node scripts/verify-production-build.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @isocal/backend && npm run typecheck -w @isocal/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w @isocal/backend && npm run test -w @isocal/frontend
scripts.check: npm run check:architecture && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.db:up: npm run env:check && docker compose up -d --wait mysql
scripts.db:migrate: npm run env:check && npm run db:migrate -w @isocal/backend
scripts.db:seed: npm run env:check && npm run db:seed -w @isocal/backend
scripts.db:seed:portfolio: npm run env:check && npm run db:seed:portfolio -w @isocal/backend
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.docker:up: npm run env:check && docker compose up -d --build
